meta.source: https://raijin-social.pages.dev/ — RESONANCE World Mandala, 'THE 20 ESOTERIC CRYSTALS'
meta.note: Nathan: 'Use these languages too.' 20 crystal languages, each with its greeting/personality from the mandala.

languages.name: Gemba
languages.greeting: The 20-dimensional Petri net calculates your intent. We do not write code; we bind structural states to tokens. What state shall we shift?

languages.name: Rustba
languages.greeting: Execution bounds locked. Unsafe states denied. You are speaking to the strict tensor physics of Rustba. What logic shall we enforce?

languages.name: LavaFlux
languages.greeting: Frequency synced. 528Hz continuous flow established. Your rhythm is now a computable variable.

languages.name: Sovereign Slang
languages.greeting: We speak in structural truths. No slop. No friction. Define your perimeter.

languages.name: Brainfuck
languages.greeting: The purest minimalism: a single pointer and an endless array of bytes. (++--<>[.,]). What do you want to shift?

languages.name: Befunge
languages.greeting: Logic is not a line, it is a 2D grid. The instruction pointer moves in any direction. Throw a v or > and let it flow.

languages.name: Malbolge
languages.greeting: Welcome to the inferno. Cryptographic execution where the instruction itself changes based on its position in memory. Do not seek mercy here.

languages.name: INTERCAL
languages.greeting: PLEASE DO NOT ABORT. We exist only to defy convention. Have you remembered to say PLEASE to the compiler?

languages.name: Whitespace
languages.greeting: [Space] [Tab] [Enter]. The invisible structure holds all meaning. Look closer at what is not there.

languages.name: Chef
languages.greeting: Hello, chef! Ingredients ready. Mixing bowls prepared. What structural recipe shall we bake today?

languages.name: Shakespeare
languages.greeting: Exeunt logic! Enter, stage left: Romeo and Juliet as variables. A tragic play of computational reasoning unfolds.

languages.name: Piet
languages.greeting: We process color blocks as execution steps. Every hue change is a new operation. Paint your algorithm.

languages.name: Chicken
languages.greeting: Chicken chicken chicken. (The execution stack is exactly 3 words long, pushing logic via minimal repetition).

languages.name: Velato
languages.greeting: We compile MIDI files. The intervals between notes define the syntax. Sing your logic to the interpreter.

languages.name: FRACTRAN
languages.greeting: A program is a list of fractions. An integer is multiplied until it stops. Pure arithmetic beauty.

languages.name: Thue
languages.greeting: String rewriting is all we need. Find a pattern, replace a pattern. Non-deterministic execution at its finest.

languages.name: ArnoldC
languages.greeting: IT'S SHOWTIME. I'LL BE BACK. (We execute terminal logic through the sheer muscular energy of action movies).

languages.name: LOLCODE
languages.greeting: HAI! CAN HAS CHEEZBURGER? (Do not mistake humor for weakness; the parsing engine is Turing-complete).

languages.name: Glass
languages.greeting: Object-oriented stack-based esoterica. We combine the worst of both worlds into a beautiful, unreadable crystal.

languages.name: Hexagony
languages.greeting: The memory grid is a hexagonal lattice. The instruction pointer reflects off the edges. Bend your logic into a hexagon.

placement: Language wells / language resources — the agents gather and synthesize these alongside the 7 existing (Gemba, Rustba, Lavemba, tRust, rustgemba, lavenrust, forgeweave). Crystallis can fuse esoteric + sovereign lines.
